en.why_it_matters: The historical weight is unusually concentrated for a club date: one of the bands that helped define UK punk in 1976 arrives fifty years later with a catalog that also helped feed goth, garage and psychedelic rock, while Flamin' Groovies add another surviving line back to pre-punk guitar culture. At 9:30 Club, that history should feel physical rather than museum-like.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for the Washington date if punk, post-punk or the genealogy of alternative rock matters to the listening thread. The anniversary framing and the 9:30 Club scale make this stronger than a routine legacy stop, while the broad international tour gives enough alternative opportunities that it should not displace a genuinely singular local event.

es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a la fecha de Washington si el punk, el post-punk o la genealogía del rock alternativo forman parte del hilo de escucha.
